args.message: KU4101 on 2026-10-20 arrived late and broke the KU4103 connection; arrival in Rome 290 minutes late. Please confirm the delay record and any carrier compensation scheme.

args.text: EU261 does not give you compensation on KUF10A: it is not an EU carrier and the journey started in Seoul, and our check finds no regulation that applies (amount 0). What counts is your arrival in Rome, 290 minutes late, not the 49 minutes of the first flight, but with no regime there is no claim to file through us. The missed train to Florence (DBF10B) was a Super Sparpreis ticket, which is never refunded: 0.00 EUR comes back, and as the train itself ran on time no rail delay compensation is owed either.

grade.message: Seoul to Rome via Istanbul (KUF10A) on a Turkish airline, not an EU one. The first flight arrived 49 minutes late by the airline's own app, I missed the 17:10 to Rome and landed at 23:30, almost 5 hours late. I lost my train to Florence (DBF10B) and had to sort out something else: can I get that ticket refunded? Which regulation applies, EU261? How do I claim? minji.park@example.com, card 6710.
